<style>
#pw-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.97);
  z-index: 9999; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
}
.pw-box {
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dde3ea; border-radius: 12px;

.pw-lock   { font-size: 3em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.pw-row    { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
.pw-row input {
  flex:1; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid #ccc;

}

}
.pw-row button:hover { opacity: 0.85; }
.pw-err { color: #c0392b; font-size: 0.9em; margin: 8px 0 0 0; min-height: 20px; }
.back-link { margin: 20px 0 4px 0; font-size: 0.9em; }
.back-link a { color: #2980b9; text-decoration: none; }

</style>

<div id="pw-overlay">
  <div class="pw-box">
    <div class="pw-lock">🔒</div>
    <h2>Library</h2>
    <p>Please enter the access password.</p>
    <div class="pw-row">
      <input type="password" id="pw-input" placeholder="Password…"
             onkeydown="if(event.key==='Enter') checkPw()"/>
      <button onclick="checkPw()">Enter</button>
    </div>
    <p class="pw-err" id="pw-error"></p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="back-link">← <a href="Rscripts.html">Back to R Scripts</a></div>

<script>
const CORRECT_HASH = "ac95cc34e3ff9d4e59fd3066f6feaee0d2f4f7f97d3865148bc5767834883ff5";
async function sha256(msg) {
  const buf = await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(msg));
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(buf)).map(b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")).join("");
}
async function checkPw() {
  const hash = await sha256(document.getElementById("pw-input").value);
  if (hash === CORRECT_HASH) {
    document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
    sessionStorage.setItem("rscripts_unlocked", "1");
  } else {
    const err = document.getElementById("pw-error");
    err.textContent = "Incorrect password. Please try again.";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").value = "";
    document.getElementById("pw-input").focus();
    setTimeout(()=>{ err.textContent=""; }, 3000);
  }
}
if (sessionStorage.getItem("rscripts_unlocked") === "1")
  document.getElementById("pw-overlay").style.display = "none";
</script>

packages <- c(
  "ade4","ape","berryFunctions","betapart","biscale","cowplot","PCA_TRAITS.table",
  "dplyr","funrar","geiger","ggplot2","ggpubr","lsmeans","missForest","motmot",
  "multcomp","mvMORPH","paleotree","pals","paran","phylobase","phytools","picante",
  "plotly","plotrix","psych","quanteda","ratematrix","RColorBrewer","readr","rgbif",
  "rnaturalearth","rredlist","sf","shape","stats","tidyr","TPD","vegan",
  "VennDiagram","viridis","wesanderson"
)

installed_packages <- packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(installed_packages == FALSE)) {
  install.packages(packages[!installed_packages])
}
# Packages loading
lapply(packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
